note: Date of service, per page, two states: (1) the key/value extractor's best date: the pair its rules accepted that the model scored highest, at any score; its confidence is that score; (2) only when key/value has no date, a label below that starts within the first or last edge_words words of the page, with a date right after it (within label_reach_chars, only label_gap_words words between, so 'Visit Date: | DOB: 01/02/1960' is not a DOS; never a date after D:, T:, DD:, DT:, TD:, TT:, Dictated or Transcribed) — an encounter label wins, else admit is From and discharge To. Otherwise no date. Edit labels here, not in dos_logic.py. Reloads on change.
note_default: DOS_DEFAULT_DATE is shown for a page with no date of its own (doc-level columns, review-ui downloads). It is never a page's Extracted DOS; it is the Final DOS of a stand-alone non-visit document (continuity_canon.json default_final_dos).
note_confidence: kv is used only for a key/value date with no score (staging from before the model ran); a scored date carries the model's own score. edge is every edge-keyword date.
